saw_lines: Deal shoppers check whether a discount is real, and they leave fast when the price looks like every other store.
So the sale is won on the deal card, where the discount must look like a real saving before anyone clicks.
Your site lists 4 deals at 33% to 70% off, so run a separate image ad for each one, starting with the 70% off bottle.
ads_1: Google image ads for each site deal, led by the 70% off bottle
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Twitter
